posts.name: Shabareesso Mariam Jose
posts.cooked: Due to Q1 coming up i was busy with studies and didnt check on BPT2 which had its deadline on march 6 th and i missed am i still eligible for OPPE the eligibility for OPPE states that The average of the first three BPT >=40/100, does this imply that BPT 1,2 and 3 are mandatory or any three BPT should be above 40%. Thank you for your response.

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked: It means avg, if you skip one by default 0 in that one. So if you cover up the avg with remaining 2 (out of the first three) then its fine.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
PlayMaker:

does this imply that BPT 1,2 and 3 are mandatory or any three BPT should be above 40

It means the average of BPT1, BPT2 & BPT3 score >= 40. So, you can calculate yourself how much you need to score (BPT1 + 0 + BPT3 )/3 to check if you are eligible or not.

To correct, BPT2 was released was on 6th March, deadline was 12th March.
